description: rules check warns about each file of a secret that other accounts may read or write: the configuration loads all the same, as version 1 takes it. A file only its owner reads gets none, nor does one that is not there, which what reads it tells of. Each warning goes once its mode is closed.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[notify.plex]
url = "https://plex.example.com"
token_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/plex.token"
[alerts]
gotify = "https://gotify.example.com"
gotify_token_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/gotify.token"
smtp = "smtps://atoll@mail.example.com?from=atoll@example.com&to=me@example.com"
smtp_password_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/none"
[api]
token_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/api.token"
[telemetry]
otlp_endpoint = "https://otlp.example.com"
otlp_logs = true
otlp_headers_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/otlp.headers"
